acceptance: BigQueryAdapter.get_query_plan returns None with str | None type annotation
Calling adapter.capture_query_plan(conn, 'SELECT 1', 'q0') on BigQueryAdapter does not raise AttributeError
Unit tests in test_cloud_saas_plan_capture.py verify both fixes
context: Adversarial audit findings QPC-DEF-01 and QPC-DEF-02. BigQueryAdapter inherited generic capture_query_plan which passed get_query_plan's dict output to the parser, crashing on .strip(). Furthermore, execute_query omitted plan_fingerprint_normalized.
description: Fix BigQueryAdapter.get_query_plan() to adhere to the base contract (str | None) by returning None instead of a dict, eliminating the AttributeError crash in generic capture_query_plan. Wire plan_fingerprint_normalized into BigQueryAdapter.execute_query when normalize_plan_literals is enabled.
